title: AgentArmy Canonical Temporal Envelope
description: The cross-cutting time contract (ARC-ADR-038). One envelope rides every CloudEvent (as v1.0 extension attributes), lands on every PinnedElement (RT5), and tags every DBOS workflow step (ARC-ADR-018). It carries the four time axes plus a causal-order axis (HLC) and the saga correlation pair, so frontend, event bus, durable runtime, and bitemporal store share one coherent notion of time. NTP/chrony is the physical baseline; the HLC is the ordering contract.

event_time.description: Occurrence time — when it happened at the source. Maps to the CloudEvents `time` attribute.

recorded_at.description: Transaction time — when the system recorded the fact. The pin-ledger axis (RT5 `recorded_at`). Server-authoritative; never client-supplied (ARC-ADR-008 discipline).

processed_at.description: Processing time — when this particular consumer handled the event. Set per hop, not propagated.

valid_from.description: Valid time (start) — when the fact becomes true in the world. Optional; present for bitemporal facts.

valid_to.description: Valid time (end) — when the fact stops being true. Null/absent = still valid.

hlc.description: Hybrid Logical Clock as `<physical_ms>:<counter>`. The causal-order axis: monotonic and happens-before-correct across containers despite wall-clock skew. Merge on receive (see tools/temporal/hlc.py).

correlation_id.description: The root process-instance id — the saga key. Constant across every nested sub-process, webhook hop, and agent invocation descended from one process start. Also the OTel trace id (ARC-ADR-010).

causation_id.description: The id of the immediate parent event/step that caused this one. With correlation_id, reconstructs the causal tree across recursive nesting.
